question: Among all patients diagnosed with SLE or SJS who were either admitted to the hospital or followed as outpatients, calculate the percentage of male patients with abnormal uric acid levels (UA > 8.0) and the percentage of female patients with abnormal uric acid levels (UA > 6.5). Only include patients who have at least one laboratory record with a non-null UA value.

prediction.sql:
WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT P.XCL_058, P.XCL_059
    FROM Patient P
    INNER JOIN Examination E ON P.XCL_058 = E.XCL_001
    INNER JOIN Laboratory L ON P.XCL_058 = L.XCL_014
    WHERE P.XCL_064 IN ('SLE', 'SJS')
      AND E.XCL_013 IN (0, 1, 2, 3)
      AND L.XCL_022 IS NOT NULL
),
stats AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(CASE WHEN P.XCL_059 = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_m,
        SUM(CASE WHEN P.XCL_059 = 'M' AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory L
            WHERE L.XCL_014 = P.XCL_058 AND L.XCL_022 > 8.0
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS abn_m,
        SUM(CASE WHEN P.XCL_059 = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_f,
        SUM(CASE WHEN P.XCL_059 = 'F' AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory L
            WHERE L.XCL_014 = P.XCL_058 AND L.XCL_022 > 6.5
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS abn_f
    FROM eligible P
)
SELECT
    100.0 * abn_m / total_m AS male_percentage,
    100.0 * abn_f / total_f AS female_percentage
FROM stats

compiled_semantic_plan.candidate_sql:
WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT P.XCL_058, P.XCL_059
    FROM Patient P
    INNER JOIN Examination E ON P.XCL_058 = E.XCL_001
    INNER JOIN Laboratory L ON P.XCL_058 = L.XCL_014
    WHERE P.XCL_064 IN ('SLE', 'SJS')
      AND E.XCL_013 IN (0, 1, 2, 3)
      AND L.XCL_022 IS NOT NULL
),
stats AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(CASE WHEN P.XCL_059 = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_m,
        SUM(CASE WHEN P.XCL_059 = 'M' AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory L
            WHERE L.XCL_014 = P.XCL_058 AND L.XCL_022 > 8.0
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS abn_m,
        SUM(CASE WHEN P.XCL_059 = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_f,
        SUM(CASE WHEN P.XCL_059 = 'F' AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory L
            WHERE L.XCL_014 = P.XCL_058 AND L.XCL_022 > 6.5
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS abn_f
    FROM eligible P
)
SELECT
    100.0 * abn_m / total_m AS male_percentage,
    100.0 * abn_f / total_f AS female_percentage
FROM stats

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
WITH base AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        P.XCL_058,
        P.XCL_059,
        CASE WHEN L.XCL_020 > 8.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS male_abn,
        CASE WHEN L.XCL_020 > 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS female_abn
    FROM Patient P
    INNER JOIN Examination E ON P.XCL_058 = E.XCL_001
    INNER JOIN Laboratory L ON P.XCL_058 = L.XCL_014
    WHERE P.XCL_064 IN ('SLE', 'SJS')
      AND L.XCL_020 IS NOT NULL
),
agg AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(CASE WHEN XCL_059 = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_m,
        SUM(CASE WHEN XCL_059 = 'M' THEN male_abn ELSE 0 END) AS abn_m,
        SUM(CASE WHEN XCL_059 = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_f,
        SUM(CASE WHEN XCL_059 = 'F' THEN female_abn ELSE 0 END) AS abn_f
    FROM base
)
SELECT
    100.0 * abn_m / total_m AS male_percentage,
    100.0 * abn_f / total_f AS female_percentage
FROM agg
